bullets.text: a spider rebuilt its web across the side mirror overnight. same car, same mirror. it has one aim and it's my commute.
three books open on the couch, none finished. each bookmark a little further back than i remember leaving it.
overcast at okunoin. duck carries a line about one aim, no halting. a stone jizō in a red bib, still facing the same way.
mildly underslept. the coffee is doing most of the talking today.
